chunks.title: Water Dispenser General Specs
chunks.content_brief: All PEL Water Dispensers come with a 1-Year Warranty (compressor and parts). They feature food-grade 304 stainless steel tanks, at least 95-100 Watt Cooling Power (3.7 Liters cold tank capacity, delivering at least 2 L/h of water at 10°C or below), 500 Watt Heating Power (1.2 Liters hot tank capacity, delivering at least 5 L/h of water at 90°C or above), and use R134a refrigerant (24-40 grams depending on model). Most models have a minimum start-up voltage of 187V.

chunks.title: Water Dispenser Series Overview
chunks.content_brief: PEL's water dispenser range splits into three series: the Desire Glass Door series (Flat Glass Door PWD-425 and Curved Glass Door PWD-525, available in Red Blaze, Purple Blaze, Maroon Blaze, Grey Blaze, and PMI Premium Mosaic finishes), the Sleek Design series for office use (a narrow, elongated chassis in Smarter/baseline and Premier/advanced tiers), and the Table Top series (a compact counter-height unit, available with or without a storage door).

chunks.series: Curved Glass, Flat Glass, Premier, Smart
chunks.title: Models with Built-in Refrigerator
chunks.content_brief: The Curved Glass Door series (PCWD-525, 3 taps), Flat Glass Door series (PWD-425, 3 taps), and the freestanding Premier (PWD-316) and Smart (PWD-315) series include a built-in cool cabinet (refrigerator) capable of storing food/drinks down to 3°C. The Premier has a 20L volume, while the others have an 18L volume.

chunks.title: Models WITHOUT Refrigerator
chunks.content_brief: Important distinction: The Pearl Basic Series (PWD-215) and Table Top (PWD-115 TT) DO NOT have a refrigerator compartment. The Pearl Basic only has a non-refrigerated storage cabinet.
